AU1.title: a new invoice is due 30 days after it is issued
AU1.intent: Add a Playwright test to the CRM-Scale suite in examples/crm-scale proving that a new invoice created from an accepted quote is due 30 days after it is issued, as shown in the invoices list.

AU2.title: the last active admin cannot be deactivated
AU2.intent: Add a Playwright test to the CRM-Scale suite in examples/crm-scale proving that the last active admin cannot be deactivated from the users page, and stays active.

AU3.title: the dashboard counts only my overdue tasks
AU3.intent: Add a Playwright test to the CRM-Scale suite in examples/crm-scale proving that the dashboard tells a signed-in user how many of their own tasks are overdue, not everyone's.

AU4.title: changing settings is audited
AU4.intent: Add a Playwright test to the CRM-Scale suite in examples/crm-scale proving that when an admin saves settings, the change is recorded in the audit log.

revision.reason: Calibration pair crm-scale-assessment-B-r0 showed seven criteria the key called covered were only partly tested (both arms agreed). Six became fault-proven natural gaps, one became ambiguous, five criteria were made precise, and the seed gained a deal won before the quarter so the won-this-quarter cutoff is testable. The calibration pair is excluded from scoring.
